ms.report:
:: UPDATES ::
Invalid/Malformed Data
The ScriptExporter uses Ply, which in turn leverages the cardano-binary and plutus-ledger-api libraries for serialization and deserialization. These packages are maintained by Intersect and would be the best sources to refer to for such test cases.

:: UPDATES ::
Enhanced Documentation
We have significantly improved our documentation to provide detailed explanations of each YTxP type as well as comprehensive setup and configuration instructions. You can now review our publicly hosted Haddock documentation at:

https://mlabs-haskell.github.io/ytxp-sdk/

Deprecation of ControlParameters.hs and Adoption of Ply
Regarding the deprecated ControlParameters.hs module, which was originally designed to bundle the YieldingScript with the SDKParams to represent what was compiled (see here for more information: https://github.com/mlabs-haskell/ytxp-lib/tree/master/docs/types#control-parameters), we have transitioned to using the ScriptExport type from the liqwid-script-export module (https://github.com/input-output-hk/xsy-liqwid-libs/tree/main/liqwid-script-export). This approach leverages Ply to manage serialization and deserialization, thereby eliminating the need for the previous ControlParameters-based functionality, and it does not affect compatibility with cardano-api or plutus-ledger-api, as the exported yielding scripts—functionally identical to the previous outputs—can be used seamlessly with these libraries (for example, see this exported JSON output: https://github.com/mlabs-haskell/ytxp-lib/blob/master/exported-scripts/ytxp-stakeValidator.json).

ms.promise:
Development of the primary components of the ytxp-lib core library, including:
・Yielding scripts: scripts (validators, minting policies, and staking validators) that are compiled against application-specific currency symbols and are capable of yielding to a set of authorized scripts
・Module Integration: Proper integration of all modules (Validators, Minting Policies, Helpers, etc.) to ensure seamless interaction within the library.
・Command line utility to read in a JSON file containing application-specific scripts to be wrapped and emit the YTxP control scripts

-Code Integrity and Style: The implementation should follow best coding practices.
-Testsuite and documentation: detailed documentation describing the modular design pattern, test suite testing happy path performance and potential attacks
